preconditions.description: The length of string s is at least 1 and at most 10^5.
The length of string t is at least 1 and at most 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: All characters in string s are lowercase Latin letters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in t)
preconditions.description: All characters in string t are lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The output is an integer representing the number of ways to extract k non-overlapping substrings from s such that each contains t as a substring, modulo 10^9 + 7.
